current_state: Karpowership proposes deploying a 250 MW floating power plant (Powership) to the Yucatan Peninsula/Quintana Roo to address grid supply shortfalls; multiple Mexican outlets (El Economista, Energia a Debate, El Heraldo de Mexico, El Sol de Mexico/OEM) reported in May 2026 that the package includes 'un buque de gas natural licuado' (an LNG vessel) alongside the powership, suggesting a marine LNG supply component rather than a purely diesel/HFO-fired unit.
